newsitem.title: CHINA: China says confident of Mideast peace process.
newsitem.headline: China says confident of Mideast peace process.

text.p: China backs the Middle East peace process and is confident of its eventual success, Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen was quoted on Wednesday as saying.
"Although the peace process is a long one, in which problems may emerge, the process will eventually succeed," Qian told a visiting Israeli delegation, according to the official China Daily.
"The Chinese government and people are much concerned about, and support, the Middle East peace process," the newspaper quoted Qian as saying.
The visiting delegation is led by Uzi Landau, chairman of the foreign affairs and defence committee of the Israeli parliament.
The newspaper gave no further details.

Talks between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation resumed under U.S. supervision in October, following serious clashes between Israeli soldiers and Palestinian police in which 75 people from both sides died.
The Israeli group arrived on Friday for a five-day stay.
